test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 15 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A man buys a cycle for ₹1600 and sells it at a loss of 20%. What is the selling price of the cycle?
solution:
**Given:**

Cost Price (CP) of the cycle = ₹1600

Loss Percentage = 20%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = CP × (1 - Loss Percentage/100)

**Calculation:**

Loss Percentage = 20%

⇒ SP = ₹1600 × (1 - 20/100)

⇒ SP = ₹1600 × (1 - 0.20)

⇒ SP = ₹1600 × 0.80

⇒ SP = ₹1280

**The selling price of the cycle is ₹1280.**
